summary.text: While specific, up-to-date (2025) employment rates for Abu Dhabi are not available, 2019 data showed a refined economic participation rate of ~72.8%, with the region contributing 26.4% of the total labor force in the Abu Dhabi Emirate. Abu Dhabi's economy is diversified, with manufacturing, trade, and transportation being significant sectors.
